stem:
Sam wanted to find three consecutive even numbers that add up to 84.
He wrote the equation k + (k + 2) + (k + 4) = 84.
What does the letter k represent?

options.label: A
options.text: The least of the three even numbers

options.label: C
options.text: The greatest of the three even numbers

options.label: D
options.text: The average of the three even numbers
